errors.text: The proposed precipitation-aging route does not reconstruct the target 6 GPa, 1473 K, 2 h HPHT treatment.
It changes the material from lamellar Al0.7CoCrFeNi FCC/B2 eutectic alloy to a W-Ni-Fe-Ta-type refractory alloy with delta and gamma-double-prime precipitates.
It omits the target transformation to a hierarchical structure with coherent FCC/B2 interfaces and the associated interphase dislocation-transfer mechanism.

The assertion that a brief high-temperature anneal generates high dislocation density is not established; annealing commonly promotes recovery unless a preceding or simultaneous deformation step is specified.
